minor.issue: Gives volume/issue/pages (20(6):743-763) that the source text (ahead of print) cannot verify.
No pooled effect sizes. It also does not note that the fixed-intensity CI (0.09-0.61) excludes zero.
'Cooling may improve tolerance during graded heat re-exposure' is not in the source.

The hydration, work-rest and emergency-plan advice is sensible but not drawn from this review. It also omits the source's specific strategy recommendations (neck collars, dousing, iced towels; avoid frozen gel packs on the eyes).
'Staff can recommend' slightly outruns the inconclusive performance evidence, though it matches the authors' own recommendation.

note: B is precise and faithful: correct SMDs with the CI-excludes-zero nuance, adverse events, median n=9, and the specific strategies the source recommends and advises against. A is accurate but generic and adds extrapolated RTS and safety content.
